name: Quake 4
description: Quake 4 is a singleplayer and multiplayer first-person shooter game and the fourth in the Quake series.

audio_settings.title: Enable EAX effects
audio_settings.reason: Quake 4 ships with its EAX sound options off, so there's no reverb and no muffling of sounds through walls.

audio_settings.title: Enable 5.1 surround sound
audio_settings.reason: Quake 4 mixes its sound for two speakers by default.

optional_settings.title: Fix low image quality
optional_settings.reason: Quake 4 can't detect how much memory modern graphics cards have, so it picks low-quality settings and loads its lowest-resolution textures.

optional_settings.title: Fix blurry text
optional_settings.reason: Quake 4 limits how sharply it draws its smaller text, so menu and HUD text looks blurry at high resolutions. A few multiplayer menus can cut off text with this on.
